Here are three ways to rewrite this, depending on the level of firmness you want to convey.

### Option 1: Firm and Direct (Recommended)
This version maintains the seriousness of the situation and the ultimatum without sounding emotional.

**Subject:** Urgent: Delivery Status Required for Item #A-118

Hello [Vendor Name],

I am writing to follow up on Item #A-118 ($2,140), which was scheduled for delivery yesterday. As of this morning, we have not yet received the shipment.

As this is the second delivery delay we have experienced this quarter, we need to ensure this is resolved immediately. Please confirm that this item will arrive no later than Thursday. Please be advised that if we do not receive the delivery by this deadline, we will be forced to move forward with canceling our contract.

I look forward to your prompt update regarding the status of this shipment.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

***

### Option 2: Concise and Formal
This version is best if you want to keep the communication strictly "by the books" and minimal.

**Subject:** Follow-up: Outstanding Delivery for Item #A-118

Hello [Vendor Name],

We are reaching out regarding Item #A-118 ($2,140), which missed its scheduled delivery date of yesterday. 

Due to this being the second delay encountered this quarter, we require the item to be delivered by Thursday at the latest. If this deadline cannot be met, we will have to initiate the cancellation of our contract.

Please provide a status update as soon as possible.

Regards,

[Your Name]

***

### Option 3: Solution-Oriented (The "Softest" Approach)
Use this if you have a long-standing relationship with the vendor and want to give them one last chance to fix it before the "hammer" drops.

**Subject:** Delivery Issue: Item #A-118

Hello [Vendor Name],

We noticed that Item #A-118 ($2,140) did not arrive yesterday as scheduled. 

Because this is the second late delivery we have encountered this quarter, we are becoming concerned about our current agreement. We need to receive this item by Thursday to avoid a formal review and potential cancellation of our contract.

Could you please confirm the current location of the shipment and ensure it reaches us by Thursday?

Thank you,

[Your Name]
